data.name: Combat Advisor
data.description: Whenever a consigliere misses with a melee attack against an opponent, he can designate an ally within 30 feet of the target to receive a +%1 insight bonus on her next attack roll against that opponent before the consigliere's next turn.|ConsigliereCombatAdvisorBonus
